# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_RIBBON_FLIP_VIX_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A midday bullish EMA ribbon flip (9 EMA crossing above 20 EMA) occurring when VIX is low (<15) and the ribbon is already stacked (20 EMA > 50 EMA) signals a shift to short‑term bullish momentum suitable for a long entry. This edge exists because low‑VIX environments suppress noise, and a confirmed ribbon flip after 11:00 EST avoids early‑morning choppiness while capturing intraday trend continuation.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** After 11:00 EST, if the 9‑minute EMA crosses above the 20‑minute EMA (bullish ribbon flip) AND the 20‑minute EMA is above the 50‑minute EMA (confirming stacked ribbon) AND the 15‑minute VIX < 15, enter long at the close of the flip bar.  
**Exit:** Initial stop set at the low of the flip bar (chart‑stop). TP1 at 1.2R; if TP1 is attained, move stop to break‑even and trail the remainder with a chandelier exit (3×ATR) from the highest high since entry. No new positions after 14:30 EST to avoid late‑afternoon noise.
